# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-4759

# Review — PAN-4759
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — `features/skill-packs.mdx` is exempted whole from the CLI-verb drift scan to hide one spec-prescribed `pan bundle` span

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-4759-review-aa2c5917
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4759/.pan/review/agent-pan-4759-review-aa2c5917/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-4759 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4759
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/4768
- HEAD reviewed: aa2c591704a55d908b0302c2dbbb2cfd5b81a519
- Base / prior cycle SHA: PRD base 312f4f2c496; prior review cycle approved 5b76d5c9ae0 (run agent-pan-4759-review-5b76d5c9)
- Spec: `.pan/drafts/PAN-4759.md`

## Delta since the prior cycle
`git diff 5b76d5c9ae0 aa2c5917` touches only `.pan/backlog/sequence.md`, `.pan/continues/PAN-4759.xbrief.json`, and **`src/lib/__tests__/agent-text-cli-verbs.test.ts` (+2)**, from commit `eaec2c93654` ("fix: allowlist pan bundle mention in skill-packs terminology note"). No docs content changed, so the prior cycle's docs findings and checks still apply to the docs files. I re-ran lint-docs at this HEAD.

## Blocking Findings

### [requirements] The new Skill Packs page is removed from the CLI-verb drift scan — `src/lib/__tests__/agent-text-cli-verbs.test.ts:58-59`
- Severity: ⊗
- Classification / scope: implementation defect (wrong repair) caused by a specification defect; in_pr_scope
- Trigger and changed-code connection: `features/skill-packs.mdx:576` contains `` `pan bundle` `` in a code span. The PAN-3868/PAN-3934 test scans code spans and fences under `features/` (`MARKDOWN_ROOTS`, lines 39-49) and flagged it as an unregistered verb, which turned CI red. Commit `eaec2c93654` then added the whole file to `PROPOSAL_DOCS`. `scan()` skips every file in `PROPOSAL_DOCS` (`if (… relative(ROOT, file) in PROPOSAL_DOCS) continue;`, line 175).
- Expected / observed / impact:
  - Expected: one proposal mention is handled without removing the page from the guard.
  - Observed: a scratch copy of the scan logic (same `COMMAND` regex, code-span/fence extraction and `COMPOSER_COMMAND_MANIFEST` registry) finds **97** `pan …` references in `features/skill-packs.mdx`. Only one is unregistered: `features/skill-packs.mdx:576: pan bundle`. The exclusion silences all 97 to hide that one.
  - Impact: this is a coverage regression that the PR introduces. At base `312f4f2c496`, all pack commands lived in `features/skills.mdx`, which was scanned (`features` is a scan root, and only `reference/template-conversations.mdx` was excluded). At this HEAD they live in an excluded file. So a later rename or deletion of a `pan skills pack …` verb no longer fails CI for the main user-facing pack page. The commit message's analogy is also wrong: `reference/template-conversations.mdx` is excluded because the whole page is an unbuilt proposal, whereas `features/skill-packs.mdx` documents the shipped feature and mentions the proposal once.
  - Constraint: non-goal 1 says "the only source edit is the stale comment at src/cli/commands/skills.ts:9". This test edit is a second source edit, and it weakens a gate.
- Evidence: static trace of `scan()`; scratch probe `npx tsx <scratchpad>/probe.ts features/skill-packs.mdx cli/skills-commands.mdx` printed `features/skill-packs.mdx:576: pan bundle` and `features/skill-packs.mdx: 97 pan references scanned`; `git show 312f4f2c496:src/lib/__tests__/agent-text-cli-verbs.test.ts` shows `features` in the scan roots and only the template-conversations exclusion. Limit: the probe repeats the test's logic in a scratch file, not by running the edited test.
- Root cause (spec defect): PRD §7.1 prescribes the section 10 text as "…describes a separate, unbuilt proposal (PAN-1357, `pan bundle`)…". That code span cannot pass the existing verb scan. The implementer followed the spec, then chose a repair that is too broad.
- Fix:
  1. In `features/skill-packs.mdx:576`, change "(PAN-1357, `pan bundle`)" to "(PAN-1357, the proposed `bundle` verb)". A bare `bundle` does not match the `COMMAND` regex `pan((?: [a-z]…)+)`. Plain-prose "pan bundle" without backticks also works, because prose is not scanned.
  2. Remove the `'features/skill-packs.mdx'` entry from `PROPOSAL_DOCS` (revert `eaec2c93654`'s test change).
  3. Spec correction: update PRD §7.1's section 10 text in the same way.
  4. Verify with `npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/agent-text-cli-verbs.test.ts`.

## Non-blocking Findings

From the prior cycle (unchanged, still valid at this HEAD):

- **~ `cli/skills-commands.mdx:213`** — `pack sageox status` exits 1 when `--project` names an unknown (unregistered) project (`skills.ts:569-580`; `listSageoxUploads` lists every registered project). It does not exit 1 for a project "with no recorded sageox state". Fix: "Exits 1 if `--project` names a project Overdeck does not know."
- **≉ `cli/skills-commands.mdx:129-131`** — "dangling launch and Codex plugin caches" should be "dangling launch links, and Codex plugin caches" (`mount.ts:396-432`).
- **? `features/skill-packs.mdx:144`** — the runbook's `ox host-contract --json` omits `OX_HOST_MANAGED=1`, which `docs/SAGEOX-FORK.md:42,81` uses to keep the probe offline. PRD-prescribed text.
- **? `features/skill-packs.mdx:23`** — the comment "turn it off again" on `inherit --project` holds only when no global value is set. PRD-prescribed; true in the quickstart flow.

CodeRabbit comments, each checked against the code (advisory input, now my own findings where valid):

- **~ `cli/skills-commands.mdx:27`** — `pan skills list --json` prints only `result.skills` (`skills.ts:60-63`). Packs and pack skills appear only in text output. State this under the `--json` row.
- **~ `cli/skills-commands.mdx:75`** — with `--browser`, `--yes` also accepts the browser consent (`skillsPackBrowserCommand(id, 'on', { yes: options.yes })`, `skills.ts:349`). The flag table says only "Trust the resolved commit".
- **~ `cli/skills-commands.mdx:81-83`** — with `--browser`, the pack is registered first (`addPack` writes the entry before line 349 runs). A declined or failed browser step exits 1 but leaves the pack registered. Say: "the pack stays registered; run `pan skills pack browser <id>` to retry the browser step".
- **~ `cli/skills-commands.mdx:137-138`** — "(rerun to retry)" conflicts with the exit path. `removePack` deletes the registry entry first, so a rerun runs the sweep again but always exits 1 with `pack <id> is not registered` (`skills.ts:486-491`), even when the sweep succeeds. Say that the rerun prints that message and then reports any remaining `Not removed:` lines.
- **~ `features/skill-packs.mdx:104`** (trust-model bullet, new text) — "else nothing is written" overclaims. `fetchPackSource` and `extractCommit` write the cache before `confirm` (`sources.ts:500-516`); only the registry entry waits for consent. Spec correction to PRD §7.4: "else nothing is registered". The same overclaim in moved text at line 79 ("before it writes anything") is pre-existing.
- **~ `docs/SKILL-PACKS.md:138-139`** — "only `addPack` (`sources.ts`) writes the registry" is imprecise. `writePackEntry` is also reached from `updatePack` and the browser enable/disable paths. The real invariant is that no repository content can create a registry entry; only `pan skills pack` commands can. PRD §7.9 item 8 prescribed this wording, so correct the spec too.
- **`docs/USAGE.md:376`** — the code span `features/skill-packs.mdx` is not a link. PRD §7.10 prescribed this exact line. Optional: `[features/skill-packs.mdx](../features/skill-packs.mdx)`.
- **`features/skill-packs.mdx:59` and `:336`** — moved text, unchanged from base (fact check). Pre-existing; out of this PR's scope.

## Coverage

### Changed-file ledger (cycle 2)
| File | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `src/lib/__tests__/agent-text-cli-verbs.test.ts` | reviewed | New in this cycle; blocking finding |
| `features/skill-packs.mdx` | reviewed | Unchanged since cycle 1 (full review there); re-probed with the verb scan |
| `cli/skills-commands.mdx` | reviewed | Unchanged since cycle 1; verb scan probe: 30 references, 0 unregistered; CodeRabbit items verified against handlers |
| `features/skills.mdx` | reviewed (cycle 1) | Unchanged |
| `docs/SKILL-PACKS.md` | reviewed (cycle 1) | Unchanged; CodeRabbit item verified |
| `reference/template-conversations.mdx`, `src/cli/commands/skills.ts`, `docs.json`, `docs/USAGE.md`, `.overdeck/context/codebase/architecture.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` | reviewed (cycle 1) | Unchanged since 5b76d5c |
| `.pan/drafts/PAN-4759.md` | reviewed | Source of the §7.1 spec defect |
| `.pan/continues/PAN-4759.xbrief.json`, `.pan/specs/…xbrief.json`, `.pan/backlog/sequence.md` | not applicable | Pipeline artifacts |

### Dimensions
- **Correctness:** the blocking finding, plus the CLI-page exit and flag wording items above.
- **Security:** no exposure. The `--yes`/`--browser` wording item matters for informed consent but changes no behavior.
- **Performance:** not applicable.
- **Requirements/UX:** FR-1..FR-17 remain met as in cycle 1. Non-goal 1 ("the only source edit is the stale comment at src/cli/commands/skills.ts:9") is violated by the test edit.

### AC matrix (cycle 2)
| AC | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| AC-1 | met | `node scripts/lint-docs.js` → `docs lint passed (86 docs files, 73 published pages)` at aa2c591 |
| AC-2, AC-3, AC-4, AC-5, AC-6, AC-7 | met | Docs unchanged since cycle 1, where each check passed; the reverse fact check also passed |
| AC-8 | unverified | CI on aa2c591: `lint-group (skills)`, `Clean install + server smoke test`, `Prompt change trailer gate`, `CodeRabbit` pass; `build (22)`, `lint-group (core/effect/state)`, `test-e2e`, `test-shard (1-4/4)` pending |
| Non-goal 1 | **unmet** | Test-file edit beyond the single allowed source edit (blocking finding) |

## Verification
- `git diff 5b76d5c9ae0 aa2c5917 --stat` → only the test file and `.pan/` artifacts changed.
- `npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/agent-text-cli-verbs.test.ts` → 6/6 pass, but only because of the exclusion.
- Scratch probe of the scan logic → `features/skill-packs.mdx`: 97 references, 1 unregistered (`:576 pan bundle`); `cli/skills-commands.mdx`: 30 references, 0 unregistered.
- `node scripts/lint-docs.js` → pass.
- `gh pr checks 4768` → see AC-8; CI tests are pending, so they are unverified.
- Full test suite: not run (role rule). `lint:effect-diagnostics`: not applicable (no TypeScript logic change).

## Scope Note
This is cycle 2. The cycle-1 approval covered 5b76d5c. The blocker is new code added after that approval (commit `eaec2c93654`), not a missed finding. The fix is one line in the mdx plus reverting two test lines.
